thesis: The discussion argues that while almost every Web3 business functions as a platform characterized by network effects, maintaining dominance is significantly harder than in Web2 because protocols can be forked and users can easily exit with their data assets. Consequently, the ideal strategy is not to lock in users for extraction but to convert them into engaged participants who have a true preference for the platform, effectively becoming the brand itself.
